Commentary.Commentary: UPDATE 1940 Local (1410 GMT) - Sadly, the rain has had the last laugh and the umpires do not see the game resuming. They have eventually decided to call off the first T20I. Disappointing for the fans who made it to the ground. There was rain throughout the day and the only time it stopped was at toss time (6.30 pm local). The umpires did come out to inspect but then the heavens opened up again and from thereon, only one decision was possible. The 2nd T20I is in Vizag and hopefully the rain stays away then. Join us on 18th September at 1900 local (1330 GMT) for that. Cheers!
